data.title: 小岭幸 · 晨扉微启的忠诚守候
data.action: 端坐在床沿，双腿并拢微倾，双手交叠静置在大腿上，粉色双马尾低垂，微歪着头眼神平静却藏着毫无保留的顺从与期待。
data.location: 主人卧室宽大窗台前，初曦微风吹动轻柔的白色纱帘
data.lighting: 白金色晨曦从侧窗漫射而入，轻纱窗帘折射出朦胧纯白漫反射光晕
data.mood: 女仆的极致奉献与克制温存，圣洁中带着微妙的反差诱惑
data.description: 主人卧室宽大窗台前，初曦微风吹动轻柔的白色纱帘。端坐在床沿，双腿并拢微倾，双手交叠静置在大腿上，粉色双马尾低垂，微歪着头眼神平静却藏着毫无保留的顺从与期待。 她微微抬眸轻语——“这是主人今日晨间唤醒服务的特别指定着装吗？幸随时遵从您的指令，请尽情检验。”
data.promptProse: Seen from a gentle low wide angle beside the tall master bedroom window at dawn, Sachi sits primly with knees together and hands folded in her lap while morning breezes lift the sheer white curtains behind her.
data.animaCaption: Seated neatly with folded hands along the sunlit master bedroom windowsill as sheer white curtains billow in the dawn breeze, she tilts her head with serene devotion wearing a maid-inspired sheer white ruffled lace bralette, frilled choker, and sheer high-cut panties.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a pure white maid-inspired sheer ruffled lace bralette with delicate apronette trim, a sheer frilled lace choker, and matching sheer high-cut panties.
